evidence.summary: Research-only hypothesis: reconstruct Chinese expressive lettering from writing-tool gesture, not contour tracing; validate optical bounds separately.
evidence.detail:
Scope: failure baseline 《地图以外》 vs 《奶奶不怕》 and related human-stopped 《三点失眠》 iterations. Old approach: generic-font deformation, geometric skeleton/SVG, automatic tracing, brush-looking effects; write/readback and vector correctness did not establish aesthetic acceptance. Do not revive the stopped case or rename an old retry.
Research source #1: designer Tien-Min Liao full author-authored article 《双语标准字：思路与实践》, 2017-10-25, https://www.thetype.com/2017/10/13558/ ; read complete article body, not claiming original project videos were seen. New tactic: for expressive lettering simulate a single plausible writing instrument with internally consistent nib/brush hardness, angle, ink, paper drag, writing speed, gestures and stroke-weight distributions; never copy Latin/other glyph outline mechanics onto Chinese strokes. Maintain recognizable native structure and check overall gray density, inner counter/negative space and visual balance.
Research source #2: 3type original report 《中文字体解密组》 V1.2 (2025-06), https://www.thetype.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/中文字体解密组报告V1.2.pdf ; sampled/visually inspected pages 5, 35, 96 and read study summary/conclusions. It studies Source Han Sans text glyphs rather than expressive brush logo; transfer only concept of real glyph bounds / boundary strokes and consistency, not its statistical numeric values as universal standards.
Testable hypothesis: an instrument-and-motion-first Chinese lettering construction, followed by per-character optical bounding and negative-space tuning, could outperform prior static-contour reconstruction at fixed content, size, number of trials and human evaluation budget.
Small A/B plan: same original Chinese wording, reference, canvas and artistic intent; A = unchanged previously human-rejected vector/contour output (no new A rerender); B = new writing-gesture construction in a separately authorized sandbox, before any vector tracing; freeze effort/iterations; blind compare recognizability, recognizable writing gesture, pen-start/end continuity, unforced stroke rhythm, optical balance and resemblance to target reference; check existing good cases for regression.
Actual execution: NONE; branch CURRENT_TASK_LOCK revision 355 reports image-generation authorization 0 and Figma-canvas authorization 0; no new pixels/files, no formal user taste review, no baseline-vs-candidate score. Status: RESEARCH_ONLY / HOLD; do not change production skills, master visual rules, checkpoint or task lock. Promote only after separate authorized test and explicit human acceptance; user rejection overrides model aesthetic scoring.
